meta.timing: best of N (all raw runs kept in 'runs'); parse time included; graph load/index build reported separately as load_ms
meta.ubc_timing: ubc_cli = end-to-end CLI wall clock (process start + license check + cached-index load + query + full JSON output); ubc_mcp = warm per-query latency against a persistent `ubc serve mcp` (stdio JSON-RPC round-trip included, result payload capped at 200 rows by the server); first MCP call discarded; load_ms = first CLI run incl. index build
meta.neo4j_timing: warm bolt query latency against a running neo4j:5 docker container, all rows fetched client-side; one untimed plan-compile run discarded; load_ms = cold JSON->Neo4j load incl. :Need(id) index; server start not included
